card.name: The word safe and its forms
card.fires_on: The words safe, safer, safety and SAFE, when they come after a linking word such as will be, both, a, the or permit. They appear in label text and in news quotes about doses and chemicals.

modes.label: Safe as an adjective
modes.description: The word safe or SAFE describes a dose, administration, or a person's state.
modes.example: there is no single theophylline dose that will provide both<< safe>> and effective serum concentrations for all patients.

modes.label: Safety as a noun
modes.description: The word safety follows 'the' and begins a statement about whether a use has been established.
modes.example: The<< safety>> of resumption of OMCAZIO

card.writes: It pushes against repeating safe or safety words next, and slightly favors odd non-English pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the word safe or safety itself, as in a safe dose or the safety of a use.
